published.source: Shaman PR (client 1.60.1.70425: new talent tree with Elemental Mastery, Fire Nova cut, Lava Burst and Mana Tide ranks, searched talents, 2026-10-16)

summary: Enhancement with Restoration points for Water Shield and Mana Tide Totem, cast at 20% mana for the group. Magma Totem rotation, and Lightning Shield kept up, which beat Water Shield at every raid hit rate tried. 7.9% behind the default at 180s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -1.5s; starting totems Strength of Earth IV, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring at -4 / -3 / -2s, and Magma Totem 1s before the pull
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20s left
Mana Tide Totem at 20% mana or less; Mana Spring waits until the tide ends
Magma Totem when it is down and at least 10s remain
Rage of the Farseer on cooldown, waiting for the on-use trinket; Blood Fury lined up with it; other cooldowns
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Fire Nova above 20% mana (ahead of the shocks)
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Earth Shock while Flame Shock has more than 1s left
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 2 a minute)
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 32 Strength and 14 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Mana Tide Totem is worth about 0.1 for the shaman itself in a 3 min fight.
Water Shield does nothing: the rotation keeps Lightning Shield up, which stays ahead even with 70425's spell-crit globes.
Orc leads on Savage (1% crit with any weapon since client 70425). Windshaper Skyborne is 2.8 behind at 180s.
Assumed: Maelstrom Weapon procs at 2 PPM per point, until the beta reaches level 34.
Elemental Focus triggers: if Stormstrike can trigger it, Enhancement gets too few Clearcasting procs.
Raid damage hits on the shaman (2 a minute, each fires Lightning Shield) are estimated from boss timers. The assumptions panel also runs 0 and 10.
Fire Nova was cut in client 70425: coefficient 0.143 (was 0.214), rank 5 base 232 to 259 (was 397 to 443).
notes: mksettings -spec enh -apl mana_tide (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid's only totem is a second shaman's Grace of Air, standards 25, the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring Totem itself) ; edited startingTotems.fire to MagmaTotem with fireSecondsBeforePull 1, as the preset ships.
